ValidationRule.description: Budget edits cannot fall below spend, approved budgets may move at most 20%, and completed projects are frozen.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT(ISNEW()), ISCHANGED(Budget__c), OR( Budget__c < NULLVALUE(Spent__c, 0), AND(Is_Approved__c, ABS(Budget__c - BLANKVALUE(PRIORVALUE(Budget__c), 0)) > 0.2 * MAX(1, BLANKVALUE(PRIORVALUE(Budget__c), 0))), AND(ISPICKVAL(Status__c, 'Completed'), Budget__c <> PRIORVALUE(Budget__c)) ) )
